topic: vietnam considers social media restrictions for minors
headline_marked: Vietnam proposes [[muting social media]] for kids under 16
headline: Vietnam proposes muting social media for kids under 16
summary: Instead of a full ban, Vietnam is considering a draft decree that would restrict users under 16 from posting, commenting, or reacting on social platforms.
details: Vietnam is exploring a novel approach to social media regulation for minors. A draft decree from the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism suggests that children under 16 would retain their social media accounts but be unable to post, comment, or react to content.

Under the proposal, accounts for users under 16 would require parental registration, with parents responsible for monitoring their children's content access and usage time. Social media platforms would be mandated to implement technical measures to identify child users and filter age-appropriate content.

The stated goal is not to prohibit social media use but to ensure children engage with it in an age-appropriate environment. This initiative follows a global trend of countries implementing or considering restrictions on youth social media access.

Several nations have already enacted or proposed similar measures. Australia was the first to ban social media for children under 16 in December 2025, imposing significant penalties for non-compliance. Austria, Canada, Denmark, and France have also introduced or are finalizing legislation to restrict social media use for minors.

These regulations aim to mitigate risks such as cyberbullying, addiction, mental health issues, and exposure to predators. However, concerns about user privacy and government overreach persist, with critics arguing that such bans may be ineffective.

headline: Apple's first foldable iPhone, iPhone Ultra, reportedly launching this fall
summary: Rumors suggest Apple's first foldable iPhone will be named iPhone Ultra and will feature six new capabilities. It's expected to launch this fall.
details: Apple is reportedly gearing up to launch its first-ever foldable iPhone this fall. Leaks and rumors suggest the device will be named the "iPhone Ultra."
While details are still emerging, reports indicate that the iPhone Ultra will boast six significant new features, setting it apart from current iPhone models.
The exact nature of these features remains speculative, but the anticipation for Apple's entry into the foldable market is high, with expectations of innovative design and functionality.
This move would place Apple in direct competition with other manufacturers who have already released foldable devices, potentially raising the bar for the category.
